Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Sistemi Engineer – Automazione (Windows/VMware)

Siamo alla ricerca di un Windows Systems Engineer con una forte passione per l'automazione e l'ottimizzazione delle infrastrutture. Ti unirai a un team dinamico di 15 esperti di ingegneria del sistema che gestiscono un'infrastruttura globale di oltre 7.000 server. Questo è un ambiente tecnico su larga scala in cui competenze, innovazione e automazione avanzata sono al centro della nostra missione.
Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'evoluzione e nella standardizzazione del nostro paesaggio IT, con un forte focus su PowerShell, VMware Aria/vRealize Automation e tecnologie Windows come Windows Server e Active Directory.
Sarete coinvolti nella progettazione, realizzazione e manutenzione di soluzioni di automazione finalizzate a migliorare l'efficienza operativa e ridurre l'intervento manuale.
Incoraggiamo attivamente l'innovazione e la proposta di nuove idee per migliorare le nostre piattaforme.
Stiamo attualmente guidando diverse iniziative strategiche, tra cui l'aggiornamento a VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9) per modernizzare il nostro stack di virtualizzazione, così come un progetto di osservabilità di nuova generazione basato su soluzioni Elastic.

Il tuo!

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere gli script PowerShell avanzati per automatizzare le attività di amministrazione del sistema.

• Distribuire, mantenere e ottimizzare i workflow e i progetti VMware Aria / vRealize Automation.

• Partecipa all'amministrazione e all'evoluzione delle piattaforme Windows, tra cui Windows Server, Active Directory / ADFS / GPO, SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager).

• Contribuire all'adozione delle pratiche Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• Assicurare prestazioni, sicurezza e affidabilità in infrastrutture virtuali e fisiche.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di rete, sicurezza e sviluppo per integrare soluzioni di automazione in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Sostenere gli sforzi di industrializzazione, le migrazioni e i progetti di miglioramento continuo.

Il tuo progetto

• Ottimo comando dell'amministrazione di Windows Server.

• Ottimo comando di PowerShell (scrittura, moduli, API, end to end automation).

• Buon comando di VMware Aria / vRealize Automation (vRA, vRO, blueprint, workflow). La conoscenza di altri componenti della suite Aria è considerata un bene.

• Conoscenza delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione (VMware vSphere).

• Conoscenza delle Infrastrutture come Codice (IaC), CI/CD applicata all'automazione, alle API REST e alle integrazioni di sistema

• L'esperienza con Azure, Terraform, GIT e Ansible è considerata una risorsa.

• Forte mentalità problem-solving e continuo orientamento di miglioramento.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente complesso.

• Forte orientamento al servizio e ottime capacità di comunicazione.

• Approccio analitico e pratiche di documentazione rigorose.

NB: Si prega di essere consapevoli del fatto che, in conformità con le normative vigenti e i requisiti di lavoro, il candidato selezionato sarà richiesto di fornire un record penale (sezione 3).

Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta il nostro pro

Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärem und beratendem Portfoliomanagement, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung bietet. Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de 300 milliards de francs et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux répartis sur 4 continents.

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières.

Repenser Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Gestion des risques des stagiaires - Stage de 6 mois - Luxembourg

Le Département de gestion des risques de Lombard Odier (Europe) S.A. est chargé de l'anticipation, de l'identification, de la mesure, du suivi, du contrôle et de la déclaration de tous les risques auxquels la banque est ou peut être exposée, y compris les risques financiers et les risques opérationnels.

Dans ce contexte, le Département de la gestion des risques surveille les risques existants et émergents, les évalue et en fait rapport à la haute direction, au Groupe et aux organismes de réglementation compétents. Il aide l'entreprise à gérer ses risques en fournissant des conseils pour promouvoir continuellement la sensibilisation aux risques.

Le service de gestion des risques recherche actuellement un étudiant ou un stagiaire pour une période de 6 mois (minimum), à compter du 1er novembre 2026.

L'emploi offre la possibilité d'acquérir une bonne vue d'ensemble de l'organisation et de l'activité commerciale d'une banque privée internationale, offrant des services de gestion de patrimoine et des services connexes aux personnes de haut niveau ayant des bureaux dans 6 marchés différents en Europe et au siège social à Luxembourg.

Les candidats acquerront une bonne compréhension des produits et des processus dans une banque privée ainsi que des techniques pertinentes de gestion des risques dans une deuxième ligne de la fonction de contrôle de la défense.

Votre rôle :

Contribuer à une gestion adéquate du ou des types de risques applicables en couvrant diverses tâches dans le département en étroite collaboration avec les responsables principaux des risques et d'autres fonctions de contrôle et d'affaires dans les différents bureaux de la Banque (y compris son siège social en Suisse):

• Risques financiers : Contribuer à la gestion des risques financiers de la Banque et effectuer des contrôles périodiques et ponctuels pertinents (principalement des contrôles liés au risque de crédit et de liquidité);

• Risques opérationnels : Contribuer aux tâches administratives dans le domaine de la gestion des incidents opérationnels, aux nouvelles initiatives opérationnelles, à l'aide à l'autoévaluation des risques et du contrôle, etc.

• Généralités: Aider à des tâches administratives dans le domaine de la gestion des risques;

• Rapports sur les risques du SAEO : Contribuer au tableau de bord mensuel du SAEO et à la préparation de la réunion du Comité de gestion des risques et de tout autre rapport interne ou externe lié à la gestion des risques

Votre profil :

• Études en cours en Master/ BA en finance, économie ou domaines connexes

• Orientation vers les résultats, organisation/priorisation des tâches

• Apprentissage ouvert et rapide

• Compétences analytiques rigoureuses

• Bonnes compétences en communication

• Joueur de l'équipe

• Compréhension des marchés et produits financiers

• Connaissances de base des techniques de gestion des risques

• Applications informatiques (utilisation avancée Excel et Access)

• La connaissance des macros et/ou de l'ABV est un avantage supplémentaire

• Compétences linguistiques : Anglais et français obligatoires. Toute autre langue a plus.

L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation stimule nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec inébranlable

• Used to handle complex client cases such as High Risk, PEP classified clients and Complex Structures

Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Agent principal de conformité de la LMA (80-100%)

Votre mission :

• Examens opérationnels du devoir de diligence conformément aux normes de la CDB, à l'ordonnance de la FINMA et à la législation suisse sur la LAM

• Effectuez des visites à bord, des changements de circonstances et des examens par événement de clients de Private Banking, en particulier mais pas seulement des marchés nationaux et internationaux suisses. Contribuer aux examens périodiques en période de pointe

• Contexte Examen des titulaires de rôles requis dans SmartKYC et les médias ouverts

• Élaborer et rédiger une évaluation des risques liés à la conformité en mettant l'accent sur :
• Objet du compte

• Structure des comptes

• Expérience professionnelle/personnelle du client

• Plausibilité et vérification SoW/SoF

• Nouvelles négatives soumises à la criminalité financière ou au financement du terrorisme, sanctions, PPE ou risque de réputation

• Évaluation des cotes de risque (risque dans le pays, industrie du risque, etc.)

• Aligner l'évaluation des risques avec l'exposition potentielle existante

• Examen des opérations, le cas échéant, pour les expositions existantes

• Gérer la présentation des cas, y compris : Évaluation des risques liés à la conformité au comité de diligence raisonnable pour les nouveaux clients à risque élevé / à risque très élevé ou classifiés PEP ou pour lesquels de nouveaux risques matériels ont été identifiés pour les clients existants

• Assurer le contrôle des actions de suivi attribuées et effectuer la validation du système dans le CRM

• Fournir des conseils de prospection et d'embarquement en ce qui concerne les clients potentiels, nouveaux ou préexistants, à risque élevé, moyen ou faible, et agir comme centre de compétence pour toutes les structures complexes et les questions connexes

• Fournir des conseils et un soutien, en ce qui a trait à toutes les questions liées à la LAM, aux équipes du bureau principal, de la gestion du cycle de vie des clients et autres, en ce qui concerne les fonctions conjointes

• Travailler pour respecter les délais serrés afin d'effectuer les examens de conformité requis conformément aux exigences réglementaires et opérationnelles

• Coopérer en temps opportun avec le Front Office afin de respecter les exigences réglementaires et stratégiques tout en tenant compte des objectifs opérationnels

• Soutenir le Swiss Head Compliance Inboarding and Review dans toutes les tâches spéciales, y compris les travaux préparatoires ou de suivi relatifs à l'audit

Votre profil :

• 6 - 8 ans d'expérience dans les examens de la diligence raisonnable et de la LAB dans le secteur des services financiers

• La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est un must avec la compréhension de toute autre langue aussi agréable d'avoir un atout

• En tant qu'agent de conformité AML, ayant été responsable des questions relatives à la diligence raisonnable des clients privés et de la couverture du marché pertinente

• Utilisé pour traiter des cas complexes tels que les clients à risque élevé, les clients classifiés PEP et les structures complexes

• Avoir une expérience approfondie de la gestion de divers aspects de la diligence raisonnable tels que la LMA, la CDB, la FATCA, la fiscalité et le SIR

• Baccalauréat en droit (ou équivalent) ou preuve d'un accomplissement académique / travail comparable

• Capacité de résumer des sujets complexes, de produire des résultats concrets et de prendre des décisions ou des propositions judicieuses, y compris l'escalade, le cas échéant, ainsi que la capacité de travailler bien sous pression et dans des délais courts

• Capacité de développer et d'écrire des évaluations de conformité détaillées en anglais avec cl

jobs.title: Internship – Operations Support Specialist
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship – Operations Support Specialist

As a member of our Operations team in Luxembourg, you will discover various Middle Office / Operations activities and learn how much they are central and critical to our Maison, worldwide. You will be an all-rounder and work with our main Operations teams, such as:

• Security Master File: Opening and updating information in the Security Masterfile database on financial instruments held by our clients.

• Income: Payment of dividends, coupons and redemptions on behalf of our clients for all markets and all types of financial instruments, including structured products and derivatives

• Reconciliation: Reconcile cash, securities, listed derivatives, precious metals, etc. Comparing transactions and balances of the Bank’s books with our network of cash counterparties, securities depositories, Transfer Agents etc.

• Operational Taxes: Preparation of tax calculations and statements for Europe- based retail clients and enterprises.

YOUR ROLE

• Assist team members in daily tasks

• Work on specific project and requests, while learning from senior peers

YOUR PROFILE

• A keen interest in the Banking sector, especially in Middle Office / Operations domains

• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently

• Motivated, detail-oriented, proactive, able to multi-task

• Fluent in French, basic English proficiency

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati ed istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari meglio capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia che dura oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Interno di supporto commerciale Integrato al comitato di gestione del servizio T&O di Lombard Odier (Europa) SA, come Business Support Intern, acquisirai esperienza pratica nella governance aziendale e supporto amministrativo per la leadership esecutiva. descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Support Intern

Integrated to the Management Committee of Lombard Odier T&O Service (Europe) SA, as a Business Support Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in corporate governance and administrative support for executive leadership. This internship will provide exposure to legal frameworks, risk management, and decision-making processes within a corporate environment. Working closely with experienced professionals, you will develop essential skills in organization, communication, and confidentiality.

YOUR ROLE
- Coordination and preparation of presentation materials for the Management Committee (Townhall, ExCo, etc)
- Drafting & circulation of meeting minutes
- Preparation of Reporting such as Reg Reporting
- Management of common mailbox,
- Coordination of internal (sport committee, etc) & external events
- Procedures/Policies Management :

• Coordination with their respective managers regarding deadlines for updating procedures

• Coordination of the formal validation process

• · Management of publications on the Intranet and communication with LOT&OS Employees

YOUR PROFILE
As the sole person in this role, you will benefit from significant autonomy and the following qualities will be expected :
- Strong organizational and anticipation skills,
- Adaptibility,
- Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills,
- High level of confidentiality,
- Strong writing skills in French and English
- Very good command of Words and Office package.

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Storage Engineer (80-100%)

We are looking for a Storage & Backup Engineer with a strong passion for enterprise infrastructure, data protection, and automation. You will join a dynamic team of 15 system engineering experts who manage a global infrastructure of more than 7,000 servers, multiple enterprise storage platforms, and mission-critical backup services supporting the Bank's operations worldwide. This is a large-scale technical environment where reliability, performance, resilience, and innovation are at the core of our mission.

You will play a key role in the design, operation, and evolution of our storage and backup ecosystem, including SAN fabrics, enterprise storage arrays, replication technologies, and data protection platforms. You will ensure the availability, performance, and scalability of critical infrastructure supporting business applications and services.

Your responsibilities will include the management and optimization of storage arrays, SAN switches and zoning configurations, Active-Active replication solutions, backup and recovery platforms, as well as performance monitoring and capacity planning across the storage landscape.

YOUR MISSION

• Design, manage, and evolve enterprise Storage, SAN, and Backup infrastructures

• Ensure the performance, availability, and resiliency of critical data storage and protection services

• Contribute to infrastructure modernization projects, including replication, disaster recovery, and object storage technologies

• Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention

• Propose innovative solutions to optimize services, enhance reliability, and reduce Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

• Maintain accurate documentation and ensure compliance with security and governance standards

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science or communication systems

• Minimum 2 years of experience in the field

• Strong knowledge of enterprise Storage and Backup technologies

• Proven experience managing storage arrays and SAN infrastructures

• Strong understanding of storage performance analysis, troubleshooting, and capacity planning

• Experience with Active-Active replication technologies and disaster recovery solutions

• Good knowledge of SAN switching, Fibre Channel protocols, and zoning concepts

• Good knowledge of S3-compatible object storage technologies

• Experience with automation using Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies

• Experience with one or more of the following products: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• Knowledge of virtualization technologies, especially VMware, is considered an asset

• Familiarity with Microsoft infrastructure technologies (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) is a plus

• Understanding of authentication and security technologies such as Kerberos, PKI, or ADFS is advantageous

• Structured, analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

• Fluent in both F

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Ingegnere di stoccaggio (80-100%)

Stiamo cercando un Storage & Backup Engineer con una forte passione per l'infrastruttura aziendale, la protezione dei dati e l'automazione. Ti unirai a un team dinamico di 15 esperti di ingegneria del sistema che gestiscono un'infrastruttura globale di oltre 7.000 server, piattaforme di storage enterprise multiple e servizi di backup mission-critical che supportano le operazioni della Banca in tutto il mondo. Questo è un ambiente tecnico su larga scala in cui affidabilità, prestazioni, resilienza e innovazione sono al centro della nostra missione.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella progettazione, il funzionamento e l'evoluzione del nostro ecosistema di archiviazione e backup, tra cui tessuti SAN, array di storage enterprise, tecnologie di replica e piattaforme di protezione dei dati. Garantirai la disponibilità, le prestazioni e la scalabilità delle infrastrutture critiche che supportano applicazioni e servizi aziendali.

Le tue responsabilità includono la gestione e l'ottimizzazione di array di storage, switch SAN e configurazioni di zoning, soluzioni di replica Active-Active, piattaforme di backup e ripristino, nonché il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la pianificazione della capacità attraverso il paesaggio di storage.

LA TUA MISSIONE

• Progettazione, gestione ed evoluzione delle infrastrutture di storage, SAN e Backup aziendali

• Assicurare le prestazioni, la disponibilità e la resilienza dei servizi di archiviazione e protezione dei dati critici

• Contribuire a progetti di modernizzazione delle infrastrutture, tra cui la replica, il ripristino dei disastri e le tecnologie di storage degli oggetti

• Guidare le iniziative di automazione per migliorare l'efficienza operativa e ridurre l'intervento manuale

• Proporre soluzioni innovative per ottimizzare i servizi, migliorare l'affidabilità e ridurre Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata e garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e governance

Il tuo progetto

• Istruzione superiore in informatica o sistemi di comunicazione

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nel settore

• Forte conoscenza delle tecnologie enterprise Storage e Backup

• Esperienza comprovata gestione array di storage e infrastrutture SAN

• Forte comprensione dell'analisi delle prestazioni di storage, della risoluzione dei problemi e della pianificazione della capacità

• Esperienza con tecnologie di replica Active-Active e soluzioni di disaster recovery

• Buona conoscenza di SAN commutazione, protocolli Fibre Channel e concetti di zoning

• Buona conoscenza delle tecnologie di storage degli oggetti compatibili con S3

• Esperienza con automazione utilizzando Ansible, Python, PowerShell o tecnologie simili

• Esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti prodotti: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• La conoscenza delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione, in particolare VMware, è considerata una risorsa

• La familiarità con le tecnologie dell'infrastruttura Microsoft (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) è un plus

• La comprensione delle tecnologie di autenticazione e sicurezza come Kerberos, PKI o ADFS è vantaggiosa

• Set mentale strutturato, analitico, proattivo e orientato alla soluzione

• Fluente in entrambi F

Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Specialista di reporting regolamentare (80-100%)

All'interno dell'unità Technology & Operations, Operazioni rende i compiti di reporting normativi per il Gruppo Lombard Odier
Il candidato di successo lavorerà all'interno del team di reporting regolamentare con 6 colleghi e sarà responsabile per la produzione, i controlli e il follow-up su tutte le segnalazioni normative come QI, FATCA, CRS, così come MiFID II, LIMF e altre segnalazioni. Inoltre, il candidato di successo aiuterà i team di tecnologia per migliorare gli strumenti e partecipare a test nuove funzionalità.
Questo individuo collaborerà principalmente con i membri del team per fornire una segnalazione normativa di alta qualità in modo tempestivo, ma anche con altri team di operazioni fiscali e altri dipartimenti (Tecnologia, Front Office, senior management, stakeholder legali e di conformità, Azioni aziendali, Settlement). L'obiettivo è quello di identificare, anticipare e seguire qualsiasi problema o cambiamento che potrebbe avere un impatto sui nostri obblighi di reporting normativo.
Il candidato di successo dovrebbe essere orientato al dettaglio, autonomo con una forte mentalità analitica, e in grado di identificare i rischi e consigliare le azioni di mitigazione, pur mantenendo una chiara comunicazione con gli stakeholder.
Regolamentazione Reporting è una zona complessa e impegnativa che è in costante evoluzione. Il team offre interessanti sfide in un ambiente di lavoro cooperativo e autonomo con un tempo di lavoro flessibile. Sarete circondati da specialisti operativi di vari sfondi.

Il tuo!

• Gestire la produzione di report regolamentari per Lombard Odier Group e alcuni clienti BPO.

• Crea nuovi e migliora i controlli dei processi aziendali per le attività esistenti e future.

• Seguire i requisiti aziendali e partecipare al test degli strumenti tecnologici dedicati.

• Liaise con i principali stakeholder, sia interni che esterni.

• Fornire supporto per l'analisi dei dati e la riconciliazione su grandi serie di dati complessi.

• Progetto e mantenimento delle procedure operative, KRI e KPI.

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea in finanza o Business Administration o equivalente; “CFC” /”Maturité professionnel bancaire” considerato.

• Precedente QI, FATCA / CRS esperienza necessaria

• Buona conoscenza generale e comprensione dei flussi bancari transazionali considerato un forte vantaggio.

• FiTAX conosce un forte vantaggio.

• Abilitato in MS Office soprattutto MS Excel.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione.

• Proattivo e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente con buona attenzione ai dettagli.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Fluente in inglese e/o francese (scritto e parlato). Altre lingue considerate un bene.

• Residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi in Svizzera.

Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata.

Come responsabile e solidale
descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Regulatory Reporting Specialist (80-100%)

Within the Technology & Operations unit, Operations renders regulatory reporting duties for the Lombard Odier Group
The successful candidate will work within the Regulatory Reporting team with 6 colleagues and be responsible for the production, controls and follow-up on all regulatory reporting such as QI, FATCA, CRS, as well as MiFID II, LIMF, and other reporting. In addition, the successful candidate will assist the technology teams to enhance the tools and take part in testing new features.
This individual will mainly collaborate with team members to deliver a high-quality regulatory reporting in a timely manner, but also with other Tax Operations teams as well as other departments (Technology, Front Office, senior management, Legal and Compliance stakeholders, Corporate Actions, Settlement). The goal is to to identify, anticipate and follow up on any issue or change that might have an impact on our regulatory reporting duties.
The successful candidate should be detail-oriented, autonomous with a strong analytical mindset, and able to identify risks and recommend mitigation actions, while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.
Regulatory Reporting is a complex and challenging area that is in constant evolution. The team offers interesting challenges in a cooperative and autonomous work environment with flexible working time. You will be surrounded by operational specialists of various backgrounds.

YOUR ROLE

• Manage the production of regulatory reporting for Lombard Odier Group and some BPO clients.

• Create new and enhance business process controls for existing and upcoming activities.

• Follow up business requirements and participate in the testing of the dedicated technology tools.

• Liaise with key stakeholders, both internal and external.

• Provide support for data analysis and reconciliation on large sets of complex data.

• Draft and maintain operational procedures, KRIs and KPIs.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor degree in Finance or Business Administration or equivalent; “CFC”/”Maturité professionnel bancaire” considered.

• Previous QI, FATCA/CRS experience required

• Good overall knowledge and understanding of transactional banking flows considered a strong advantage.

• FiTAX knowledge a strong advantage.

• Skilled in MS Office especially MS Excel.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Proactive and able to work independently with good attention to detail.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Fluent in English and/or French (written and spoken). Other languages considered an asset.

• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate to Switzerland.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärem und beratendem Portfoliomanagement, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung bietet. Regulatory Reporting Specialist (80-100%)

Sie werden von operativen Spezialisten verschiedener Hintergründe umgeben sein.

• Verwalten Sie die Erstellung von regulatorischen Berichten für die Lombard Odier Group und einige BPO-Kunden.

• Erstellen Sie neue Geschäftsprozesskontrollen für bestehende und kommende Aktivitäten.

• Ausarbeitung und Aufrechterhaltung von Betriebsverfahren, KRI und KPI.

IHR PROFIL

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finance oder Business Administration oder gleichwertig; "CFC" / "Maturité professionnel bancaire" betrachtet.

• QI, FATCA/CRS Erfahrung erforderlich

• Ein gutes Gesamtwissen und Verständnis der Transaktionsbankströme wurde als großer Vorteil angesehen.

• FiTAX Wissen ein großer Vorteil.

• Kenntnisse in MS Office, insbesondere MS Excel.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Proaktiv und in der Lage, unabhängig mit guter Liebe zum Detail zu arbeiten.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Fließend in Englisch und / oder Französisch (geschrieben und gesprochen). Andere Sprachen betrachteten einen Vermögenswert.

• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bereit, in die Schweiz umzuziehen.

Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents.

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Spécialiste des rapports réglementaires (80-100%)

Au sein de l'unité Technologie & Opérations, Operations rend des obligations réglementaires pour le groupe Lombard Odier
Le candidat retenu travaillera au sein de l'équipe des rapports réglementaires avec six collègues et sera responsable de la production, du contrôle et du suivi de tous les rapports réglementaires tels que QI, FATCA, CRS, ainsi que MiFID II, LFMI et d'autres rapports. De plus, le candidat retenu aidera les équipes technologiques à améliorer les outils et à participer à l'essai de nouvelles caractéristiques.
Cette personne collaborera principalement avec les membres de l'équipe pour produire des rapports réglementaires de haute qualité en temps opportun, mais aussi avec d'autres équipes des Opérations fiscales ainsi qu'avec d'autres ministères (technologie, Front Office, haute direction, parties prenantes du secteur juridique et de la conformité, actions des sociétés, règlement). L'objectif est d'identifier, de prévoir et de suivre toute question ou tout changement qui pourrait avoir une incidence sur nos obligations en matière de rapports réglementaires.
Le candidat retenu devrait être axé sur les détails, être autonome et avoir une solide capacité d'analyse et être en mesure d'identifier les risques et de recommander des mesures d'atténuation, tout en maintenant une communication claire avec les intervenants.
Les rapports réglementaires sont un domaine complexe et difficile qui évolue constamment. L'équipe présente des défis intéressants dans un environnement de travail coopératif et autonome avec un temps de travail flexible. Vous serez entouré de spécialistes opérationnels de différents horizons.

Votre rôle

• Gérer la production de rapports réglementaires pour Lombard Odier Group et certains clients BPO.

• Créer de nouveaux mécanismes de contrôle des processus opérationnels pour les activités existantes et à venir.

• Suivre les exigences opérationnelles et participer aux essais des outils technologiques dédiés.

• Assurer la liaison avec les principaux acteurs, tant internes qu'externes.

• Fournir un appui pour l'analyse et le rapprochement des données sur de grandes séries de données complexes.

• Élaborer et maintenir des procédures opérationnelles, des IRC et des IRC.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Baccalauréat en finance ou en administration des affaires ou l'équivalent; CFC.

• Expérience préalable en QI, FATCA/CRS requise

• Une bonne connaissance générale et une bonne compréhension des flux bancaires transactionnels ont été considérées comme un avantage important.

• FiTAX connaît un fort avantage.

• Compétence en MS Office, en particulier MS Excel.

• Excellentes compétences en communication.

• Proactive et capable de travailler de manière indépendante avec une bonne attention aux détails.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Fluent en anglais et/ou en français (écrit et parlé). D'autres langues sont considérées comme un atout.

• Résident en Suisse ou désireux de déménager en Suisse.

L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable.

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Head of Identity and Access Management (80-100%)

Join Lombard Odier as Head of IAM and contribute to establishing robust identity and access management practices, protecting our critical assets and ensuring compliance with industry regulations.

YOUR ROLE

The Head of Identity & Access Management (IAM Manager) oversees all activities related to identity and access management to ensure the security, integrity, and compliance of information systems. They lead the IAM team (administrators, analysts), define the IAM vision and strategy, and ensure that the right users have the right access to the right systems at the right time.

The IAM Manager plays a key role in protecting the company’s information assets by ensuring alignment between business needs, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.

This role includes:

Leadership & Management:

• Define operational objectives, monitor performance, manage priorities, and ensure service quality.

• Oversee activities related to SLAs, security KPIs, and compliance indicators.

IAM Governance & Strategy:

• Define, maintain, and evolve the IAM strategy, including Identity Governance (IGA).

• Develop and enforce policies, standards, and procedures in line with regulatory frameworks.

• Implement and supervise controls, audits, and periodic access reviews.

IT / Business Collaboration & Integration:

• Co-design integrated solutions.

• Collaborate with HR, business teams, and management to facilitate onboarding, mobility, and offboarding processes.

• Raise awareness among employees on best practices.

Technology & Innovation:

• Drive the IAM technology roadmap: modernization, automation, integration of new tools, and workflow improvements.

• Maintain active monitoring of industry trends.

YOUR PROFILE

You know how and enjoy:

• Building, leading, and developing a team.

• Exploring new topics, learning, and deepening knowledge.

• Defining a vision and surrounding yourself with the right people to deliver it.

• Communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Designing and delivering value-added services.

• Working in a dynamic and complex environment.

• Taking calculated risks within your scope of responsibility.

Ideally:

• You have solid knowledge of IAM solutions (CyberArk, Okta, or similar).

• You are familiar with key IAM concepts (RBAC, Need-to-Know, Need-to-Do).

• Your experience includes participation in internal or external audits.

NB: Please note that, in accordance with applicable laws and the role requirements, the selected candidate will be required to provide a criminal record extract (section 3).

Identity & Access Management Administrator (80-100%)

Within the IT Operations department, you will join Lombard Odier’s Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, responsible for managing identities, access, and associated security for more than 3,000 employees.

In the context of a transformation toward Zero Trust, RBAC, and cloud/hybrid models (Entra ID / Azure AD), you will actively contribute to securing and automating the identity lifecycle.

YOUR ROLE

Identity & Access Management:

• Process and analyze access requests via ITSM tools (ServiceNow)

• Ensure access provisioning / deprovisioning and resolve IAM incidents

• Manage identities, accounts, and groups in Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)

• Administer access rights (NTFS, file shares, business applications)

• Monitor Joiners / Movers / Leavers (JML) processe

Automation & Continuous Improvement:

• Contribute to IAM process automation (workflows, scripting, APIs)

• Support the improvement of access models (RBAC / ABAC)

• Integrate new applications into the IAM ecosystem (SSO, provisioning, federation)

• Participate in the transition toward Zero Trust and identity-first architectures

Identity Governance & Security:

• Manage and improve access assignment workflows (IGA)

• Participate in access recertification campaigns

• Administer privileged access via a PAM solution (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, etc.)

• Contribute to the management of sensitive access and secrets (Vault)

• Support compliance controls and audits (FINMA, ISO, etc.)

Support & Collaboration:

• Provide Level 2/3 support on IAM-related issues

• Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Risk teams

• Write and maintain technical procedures and IAM documentation

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong experience in IAM (Identity & Access Management)

• Excellent knowledge of Active Directory (on-prem) and Entra ID / Azure AD

• Good understanding of RBAC / ABAC concepts, SSO (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC), provisioning / SCIM

• Experience with an IAM / IGA tool (e.g., SailPoint, One Identity, Saviynt, ServiceNow IAM)

• Experience or exposure to PAM solutions

• Strong knowledge of Windows Server environments and access security

• Scripting / automation / GenAI knowledge (PowerShell, APIs, Copilot) is highly valued

• Experience in a banking or regulated environment

• Knowledge of Zero Trust / Identity Security models

• Familiarity with ServiceNow and monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, Elastic, SIEM)

• Experience in application integration (SSO / federation)

• Understanding of Cloud & Hybrid Identity challenges

• Attention to detail and strong security mindset

• Analytical skills and ability to solve complex problems

• Team player with excellent interpersonal skills

• Autonomous and proactive

• Ability to work in a demanding and evolving environment

• Fluent French and professional English required

Business Risk Manager - Technology & Operations (80-100%)

As part of the Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management team, you will partner with stakeholders across Operations and Technology to identify key risks, coordinate remediation, and strengthen first‑line ownership of controls. You will contribute to the effective oversight of operational, technology and information risks, and ensure transparent and timely reporting to management.

YOUR ROLE

Risk Identification, Assessment & Reporting

• Identify, assess, and report operational risks, including processing, trade order execution, operational taxes, technology, cybersecurity, and information‑related risks across T&O.

• Support the RCSA process and ensure risk assessments remain current, well‑documented, and evidence‑based.

• Manage the T&O incident process, ensuring incidents are recorded, analysed, escalated, and followed through to closure.

Control Environment Oversight

• Contribute to the T&O Risk Assurance Plan through thematic reviews, independent design and operating effectiveness testing of the control environment, and follow‑up of identified gaps.

• Support the ISAE control framework, ensuring required evidence is collected, complete, and audit‑ready.

Remediation & Issue Management

• Drive, coordinate, and track risk remediation activities, ensuring actions are well defined, owned, and delivered on time.

• Monitor and report on the progression of identified issues, ensuring consistent closure, documentation, and controls uplift.

Governance, Assurance & Culture

• Promote a strong risk culture by supporting awareness, training, and constructive challenge across teams.

• Prepare structured and insightful risk reports to the T&O Risk Committee and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 5 years' experience in risk management, internal control, audit, or consulting (e.g., Big Four) with focus on operational or technology‑related risks.

• Solid understanding of operations, IT, cybersecurity, and information risk, ideally within financial services.

• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, detail‑oriented approach.

• Excellent communication skills in English and French, with the ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging (80-100%)

Lombard Odier group operates its own proprietary banking technology platform, used internally and offered to external financial institutions through a BPO business model. The Technology & Operations (T&O) department is responsible for maintaining and enhancing this platform by delivering robust and scalable solutions to support the Bank’s activities.

As part of the continuous evolution of our Operations Back-Office capabilities, we are looking to strengthen our team with an IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging.
The role covers a functional perimeter including interbank messaging, reconciliation processes, and client notifications (account statements, advices). It also provides the opportunity to develop expertise in SWIFT package integration, working at the intersection of business analysis and technical implementation.

We are open to SWIFT package integrators willing to expand their functional knowledge, as well as Business Analysts with a technical background eager to develop integration skills.
You will join the Interbank Messaging Team and work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders across Operations and IT.

YOUR ROLE

• Collect, analyze, and formalize business requirements related to interbank messaging (SWIFT), reconciliation, and client notifications.

• Act as the interface between business and IT teams, ensuring shared understanding of needs and constraints.

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and evolution of SWIFT-related solutions (FIN, MT/MX, interfaces).

• Participate in SWIFT package integration (configuration, testing, deployment).

• Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria with Product Owners and technical teams by translating business needs into technical requirements

• Ensure end-to-end consistency of messaging flows, including reconciliation and downstream impacts.

• Support incident resolution and root cause analysis.

• Drive continuous improvement of systems, data quality, and processes.

• Maintain documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Monitor SWIFT standards evolution and market practices.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related field (Master’s a plus).

• Experience as a Business Analyst / Technical BA / SWIFT Integrator in payments, securities, or interbank messaging environments.

• Good knowledge of SWIFT standards (MT/MX), reconciliation, and messaging flows.

• Solid understanding of data flows, system integration concepts (SQL, APIs, messaging, data models) and software development tools (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow)

• Strong communication skills in French & English.

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and prioritization skills.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Senior IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / File Transfer / Monitoring (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform (renewal of our platforms), we are looking for production engineers familiar with technologies around file transfer, scheduling and alerting, who will be able to support us throughout this transformation, while at the same time supporting the current installed base.

Management of an application pool within the IT Operations department (Technologies and Operations unit), in a team of 7 employees operating from Geneva.

YOUR MISSION

• Responsible for implementing business requests on our alerting/scheduling/file transfer platforms

• Qualification of requests, detailed documentation of specs

• Actively participate and make proposals for the evolution of the platforms

• Actively participate and make proposals to improve and automate existing processes

• Level 2/3 support for existing workflows

Internal Contacts:

• Steering committee

• Production team (Product-Support)

• Integration team

• All technical teams (Data bases, System, Telecom, Citrix,)

• Development teams based in Geneva

• Support teams (Service Desk and Application Support)

• Service Management teams (Incidents and Problems)

External Contacts:

• Suppliers of external products and/or services

• Technical sponsors of certain banking infrastructure customers

• Technical sponsors of partners of our banking infrastructure customers

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science (Master's degree or equivalent)

• 2 to 10 years in a similar position

• Significant experience on file transfer: implementation of industrial transfer protocols, certificate management. GoAnywhere would be a plus

• Scheduling: OpCon, Control-M or equivalent would be a plus

• Monitoring/alerting: Service Now Event Management, Nagios, SCOM, scripting (Powershell, shell) would be a plus

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, flexible and with good interpersonal skills. Strong team spirit, desire for continuous improvement, proactive.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)

• Residence in Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

jobs.title: Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%)

Within the IT Operations unit, our team (16 people between Luxembourg and Geneva) is dedicated to integrate new business applications into our ecosystem according to the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure and Dev). Our team makes our core app evolution easier and smoother, without compromising quality.

YOUR ROLE

• Manage the release management process to reduce operational risk in prod and test environments:

• Coordinate planned changes between dev and production teams

• Facilitate the Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings

• Efficiently integrate new business applications into the ecosystem from design to implementation in various environments (Dev/Test/UAT and prod)

• Coordinate and execute technical tasks based on the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure/provider and Dev)

• Identify and mitigate risks, technical issues, and dependencies across the project

• Collaborate with the Provider (Third-party Package) on Lombard Odier technical requirements

• Develop the project's reference document in collaboration with Dev

• Estimate the workload of IT tasks during the project

• Implement continuous improvement using the Problem Management process to reduce downtime for business applications- Internal stakeholders: Development, Service Management (Incident/Problem Management), DBA, Network, Citrix/Virtualization, Tooling, IT Security, IT Risk.

• External stakeholders: Software and Service Vendors, Business Process Outsourcing Clients (Banks who are using our IT Platform and services)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master in IT or equivalent

• Good command of development languages and linked application servers: JAVA, JBOSS, C++

• Good command of CI/CD tooling: Openshift, Kubernetes, DevOps principles

• Good command of production tooling: FTP transferts, schedulers

• Previous experience of the Banking sector will be an asset

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, with good interpersonal skills and team spirit. Ready to propose enhancements and participate to continuous improvment initiatives.

• Fluent in English and French

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

• Service Now

• Serena

• ArgoCd

• NetScaler

• Java

• Apache/IIS

• Openshift

• Kubernetes

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

jobs.title: Sustainability Research Analyst
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Working within the Sustainable Investing team, the Sustainability Research Analyst will play an integral role in the implementation, development and ongoing enhancement of Lombard Odier’s proprietary sustainable investment framework. By ensuring credibility and consistency, this function is central to the firm’s sustainable investment offering and entails interactions with investment teams and other internal stakeholders across the firm’s asset management and private banking activities. Initial responsibilities will focus on the application of the framework to sustainability assessments, with scope over time to take ownership of specific workstreams related to the framework’s development and implementation.

Sustainability Research Analyst (80-100%)

Your Role :

• Assess companies and labelled debt instruments against the firm’s proprietary sustainable investment framework using company disclosures, third-party sustainability data, and other external sources; author written assessments for internal and client-facing use

• Contribute to the continued development of qualitative framework criteria through sector and value chain research; support improvements to data-driven framework criteria by leveraging external datasets and internal tools.

• Monitor developments in sustainability regulation, standards, frameworks, and emerging sustainability themes

• Work with investment teams and other internal stakeholders to explain assessment outputs, support new investment ideas and respond to sustainability-related due diligence or client requests

• Contribute to improving workflows and documentation related to the sustainable investment framework and investment processes, including through the introduction of AI-enabled workflows

• Generate research insights and collaborate with the investment stewardship team on company engagement

Your Profile :

• Degree or postgraduate qualification in sustainability, environmental science, public policy or a related field; sustainability-focused professional experience may substitute for a sustainability-specific academic background

• Prior experience in sustainability/ESG research, sustainability consulting, sustainable finance, or sustainable capital markets

• Demonstrated experience analysing companies, sectors, business models and corporate disclosures from the perspective of sustainability-related risks, opportunities and impacts

• Strong understanding of environmental and social sustainability issues and their interconnections, as well as sustainability frameworks, certifications and standards

• Intellectual curiosity and the ability to think conceptually about the intersections of financial markets, corporate performance, and environmental and social issues

• Comfort with ambiguity and making judgments with incomplete or imperfect data

• Ability to interpret and organise complex qualitative and quantitative information

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects

Preferred skills :

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Lavorando all’interno del team di Investimento Sostenibile, l’Analista per la Ricerca Sostenibilità svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell’attuazione, nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento continuo del quadro di investimento sostenibile di Lombard Odier. Garantire credibilità e coerenza, questa funzione è fondamentale per l’offerta di investimento sostenibile dell’azienda e comporta interazioni con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni attraverso la gestione patrimoniale e le attività bancarie private. Le responsabilità iniziali si concentreranno sull’applicazione del quadro alle valutazioni di sostenibilità, con lo scopo nel tempo di prendere possesso di specifici flussi di lavoro relativi allo sviluppo e all’attuazione del quadro.

Analista di ricerca di sostenibilità (80-100%)

Il tuo ruolo:

• Valutare le aziende e etichettare gli strumenti di debito contro il framework di investimento sostenibile proprietario dell’azienda utilizzando le informative aziendali, i dati di sostenibilità di terzi e altre fonti esterne; autorizzare valutazioni scritte per l’uso interno e client-facing

• Contribuire al continuo sviluppo di criteri quadro qualitativi attraverso la ricerca nel settore e nella catena del valore; sostenere i miglioramenti ai criteri di framework basati sui dati sfruttando i set di dati esterni e gli strumenti interni.

• Monitorare gli sviluppi in materia di regolamentazione, standard, framework e temi di sostenibilità emergenti

• Lavora con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni per spiegare gli output di valutazione, sostenere nuove idee di investimento e rispondere alle richieste di due diligence legate alla sostenibilità o ai clienti

• Contribuire a migliorare i flussi di lavoro e la documentazione relativa al quadro di investimento sostenibile e ai processi di investimento, anche attraverso l'introduzione dei flussi di lavoro abilitati all'IA

• Generare intuizioni di ricerca e collaborare con il team di stewardship di investimento sul coinvolgimento aziendale

Il tuo profilo:

• Titolo di laurea o post-laurea in sostenibilità, scienze ambientali, politica pubblica o un campo correlato; esperienza professionale orientata alla sostenibilità può sostituire uno sfondo accademico specifico per la sostenibilità

• Esperienza prioritaria nella ricerca sulla sostenibilità/ESG, consulenza sulla sostenibilità, finanza sostenibile o mercati dei capitali sostenibili

• Esperienza dimostrata analizzando aziende, settori, modelli di business e divulgazione aziendale dalla prospettiva di rischi, opportunità e impatti legati alla sostenibilità

• Forte comprensione dei problemi di sostenibilità ambientale e sociale e delle loro interconnessioni, nonché dei quadri di sostenibilità, delle certificazioni e degli standard

• La curiosità intellettuale e la capacità di pensare concettualmente alle intersezioni dei mercati finanziari, delle prestazioni aziendali e delle questioni ambientali e sociali

• Comfort con ambiguità e giudizio con dati incompleti o imperfetti

• Capacità di interpretare e organizzare complesse informazioni qualitative e quantitative

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e di prendere la proprietà dei progetti

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Working within the Sustainable Investing team, the Sustainability Research Analyst will play an integral role in the implementation, development and ongoing enhancement of Lombard Odier’s proprietary sustainable investment framework. By ensuring credibility and consistency, this function is central to the firm’s sustainable investment offering and entails interactions with investment teams and other internal stakeholders across the firm’s asset management and private banking activities. Initial responsibilities will focus on the application of the framework to sustainability assessments, with scope over time to take ownership of specific workstreams related to the framework’s development and implementation.

Sustainability Research Analyst (80-100%)

Your Role :

• Assess companies and labelled debt instruments against the firm’s proprietary sustainable investment framework using company disclosures, third-party sustainability data, and other external sources; author written assessments for internal and client-facing use

• Contribute to the continued development of qualitative framework criteria through sector and value chain research; support improvements to data-driven framework criteria by leveraging external datasets and internal tools.

• Monitor developments in sustainability regulation, standards, frameworks, and emerging sustainability themes

• Work with investment teams and other internal stakeholders to explain assessment outputs, support new investment ideas and respond to sustainability-related due diligence or client requests

• Contribute to improving workflows and documentation related to the sustainable investment framework and investment processes, including through the introduction of AI-enabled workflows

• Generate research insights and collaborate with the investment stewardship team on company engagement

Your Profile :

• Degree or postgraduate qualification in sustainability, environmental science, public policy or a related field; sustainability-focused professional experience may substitute for a sustainability-specific academic background

• Prior experience in sustainability/ESG research, sustainability consulting, sustainable finance, or sustainable capital markets

• Demonstrated experience analysing companies, sectors, business models and corporate disclosures from the perspective of sustainability-related risks, opportunities and impacts

• Strong understanding of environmental and social sustainability issues and their interconnections, as well as sustainability frameworks, certifications and standards

• Intellectual curiosity and the ability to think conceptually about the intersections of financial markets, corporate performance, and environmental and social issues

• Comfort with ambiguity and making judgments with incomplete or imperfect data

• Ability to interpret and organise complex qualitative and quantitative information

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects

Sustainability Research Analyst (80-100%)
